text:
lina (pm): Quick thread: propose a "microcommit" pathway — small monthly commitments that unlock predictable routing/discounts without full Dedicated. Aim: reduce friction for startups moving off pure payg.

jon (sales): customers keep asking for something between payg and reserved. key asks: predictable latency during spikes, and a simple upgrade path.

marc (eng): infra sketch: per-tenant commit % -> routing weight + optional soft reserve. Need token accounting and a small admin UI. Est 2 sprints for pilot (US-only).

priya (finance): pricing idea: $99/mo entry commit + 10% discount on token price up to commit. Need sensitivity model for 5/10/20 pilot signups.

kate (legal): contract note: define "microcommit" term, change windows, and overage calc; include safety carveouts for routing changes. Will draft short addendum.

sam (devex): SDK: tenant flag + per-request override. Will add quickstart and an eval harness to compare commit vs payg quality.

nate (ops): ops: soft-reserve in single region for pilot. committed capacity only if customer upgrades. Need QPS estimates.

lina (pm): Launch checklist: MRD + pricing sheet, legal addendum, 3 pilots, devex quickstart, ops pool. Owners: lina (PM), marc (eng), jon (sales), priya (finance). Kickoff Wed 10am PT. Any objections?

jon (sales): none. I'll recruit pilots and collect QPS.

priya (finance): will run the break-even models by Tue.

kate (legal): will post redlines tomorrow.

marc (eng): good to go from infra side.

sam (devex): will prepare docs.

nate (ops): will confirm pool sizing after QPS.
